universe.identity_matching: EXACT_IDX_NM_WITHIN_OWN_MARKET_RESPONSE; identity = MARKET + '::' + IDX_NM; no alias, rename or fuzzy inference
universe.ranking: DESCENDING relative strength within benchmark scope; tie-break SERIES_IDENTITY_ASC

sessions.session_rule: A date is a session only when both the KOSPI and KOSDAQ index responses for that basDd are non-empty with BAS_DD equal to the request. Dates are never classified as sessions by weekday arithmetic.
sessions.calendar_cross_check: Where an official KRX [01023] holiday capture exists for the year, a calendar CLOSED date with rows, or a calendar OPEN_REGULAR date with empty responses, is a DISAGREEMENT.
study_blocking_conditions: backfill stopped (HTTP 401/403/429, response error code, schema/date violation, budget exhaustion, consecutive transient failures)
any request left BLOCKED after retries
any KOSPI/KOSDAQ or calendar/response session DISAGREEMENT
records payload hash does not match the backfill receipt
sessions.blocked_result: status BLOCKED, reason recorded, no candidate statistics emitted

coverage_rule.window: Per scope, the longest run of consecutive confirmed sessions ending at the last confirmed session in which the benchmark and every member have a numeric positive close. No forward fill.
coverage_rule.insufficient_result: If either scope window is shorter than the minimum, the study status is INSUFFICIENT_EXACT_IDENTITY_COVERAGE and no candidate statistics are emitted. Identity first/last presence is still reported.

definitions.relative_strength: RS_L(e,t) = ln(P_e,t / P_e,t-L) - ln(B_t / B_t-L), L = 20 primary; L = 1 only for the explicitly labelled current-temporary-basis comparison
definitions.buckets: TOP = ranks 1..3, BOTTOM = last 3 ranks, MIDDLE = rest, within scope
definitions.execution: signal known at close t, executed at close t+1
definitions.forward_excess: FX_h(e,t) = ln(P_e,t+1+h / P_e,t+1) - mean over all members of the same scope of ln(P_x,t+1+h / P_x,t+1)
definitions.baseline_hit_rate: share of FX_h(e,t) > 0 over every member and every ranked t with an available forward return, pooled across scopes
definitions.non_overlapping_n: greedy per sector in time order, events at least h sessions apart
definitions.recent_segment: per scope, signal sessions with index >= T - main_horizon - 1 - 120 (about the last 120 signal sessions with an available main-horizon return)
definitions.halves: per scope, signal index below / at-or-above the midpoint of the ranked range

candidates.rule: ENTER at t when TOP on 1 consecutive observation ending t and not TOP at t-1, while not held
ENTER at t when TOP on 2 consecutive observations ending t and not TOP at t-2, while not held (ratified 2-consecutive confirmation)
ENTER at t when TOP on 3 consecutive observations ending t and not TOP at t-3, while not held
after R1-k1 ENTER: first t with BOTTOM, or non-TOP at t and t-1 with t-1 after entry
after R1-k2 ENTER: first t with BOTTOM, or non-TOP at t and t-1 with t-1 after entry (ratified release rule)
after R1-k3 ENTER: first t with BOTTOM, or non-TOP at t and t-1 with t-1 after entry
R1-k2 ENTER kept only if mean ACC_TRDVAL over last 5 sessions / mean over last 20 sessions >= 1.0 at t (index trading value; missing value drops the event and is counted)
MIDDLE or BOTTOM at t and rank improved by >= 3 places vs t-5, no WATCH for that sector in the previous 5 observations; display-only rule, tested as a buy signal
RRG-style approximation: X = P_e / P_B, RSR = 100 * X / SMA_20(X), RSM = 100 * RSR_t / RSR_t-5; quadrant becomes LEADING (RSR>100 and RSM>100) from any other
RRG-style: quadrant becomes LAGGING (RSR<=100 and RSM<=100) from any other
top-3 momentum baseline: every ranked t, each of the top 3 members by trailing 20-session log return within scope
comparison on the current temporary 1-session basis (L = 1): same as R1-k2_ENTER
comparison on the current temporary 1-session basis (L = 1): same as R1-k2_EXIT

descriptive_only: R5_REBALANCE_20: every 20 sessions from t = 20 while t+21 < T, hold top 3 by trailing 20-session log return; per-rebalance mean FX_20 of the 3 picks (count, mean, hit share, mean without best, last 6 rebalances per scope, halves)
whipsaw share per k (EXIT within 5 observations of ENTER), median held observations for R1-k2
R3 WATCH -> R1-k2 ENTER within 10 observations conversion share
TOP-3 day-to-day persistence share for L = 20 and L = 1

gates.evaluated_at: main horizon (10 sessions) only; other horizons reported without verdict

pass_requires_all: mean without the single best event > 0
recent segment has at least 1 event and recent mean >= 0
both scope means > 0 and positive-mean sectors > half of sectors with n >= 3
enter.otherwise: FAIL with the failing checks listed

justified_requires_all: mean without the single worst event < 0
recent segment has at least 1 event and recent mean < 0
exit.otherwise: NOT_JUSTIFIED with the failing checks listed

ratified_structure_verdict.ENTRY_ONLY_SUPPORTED: R1-k2_ENTER PASS and R1-k2_EXIT not JUSTIFIED
ratified_structure_verdict.RELEASE_ONLY_SUPPORTED: R1-k2_EXIT JUSTIFIED and R1-k2_ENTER not PASS
ratified_structure_verdict.INSUFFICIENT: R1-k2_ENTER or R1-k2_EXIT INSUFFICIENT and neither of the above

gates.multiple_testing_note: Count of gated candidates and passes is reported; a single borderline pass among many tests can be chance.

outputs.public: aggregate statistics, counts, verdicts, per-sector event counts and mean excess, identity coverage counts and first/last presence dates, request accounting, response SHA-256 manifest and input hashes
outputs.never_public: index closes, trading values, per-day relative strength, ranks, quadrants, per-event dates or returns, raw responses

post_hoc_policy: No parameter in this file changes after data is fetched. Any additional variant must be labelled POST_HOC in a separate document.
